title: service-knowledge: the realtime event bridge keeps a record.* branch that no in-repo producer feeds, and its option TSDoc names record.* as the ObjectQL events it syncs
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357). It comes from the at-tier contract review of PR #20567 (#20288; record `5883544890`, ③), which escalated this out-of-scope finding from the #20288 dev report (`5883321020`). ⛔ Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the code does (read at `origin/main`, `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/`)

- `knowledge-service-plugin.ts`, the `IRealtimeService` subscription handler:
  - `data.record.created` / `data.record.updated` read the record from `payload.after` (around :168);
  - `data.records.updated` / `data.records.deleted` warn that a bulk event carries a count;
  - a separate branch still handles `record.created` / `record.updated` (:218-224), reading `payload.record ?? payload`, and `record.deleted` (:225-230), reading `payload.id ?? payload.record.id`.
- The comment above the `data.record.*` branch (from #4626) says that branch is "Kept separate from the legacy `record.*` shape rather than merged behind fallbacks".
- The plugin option's TSDoc (around :24) reads "Subscribe to ObjectQL `record.*` events from `IRealtimeService`". `knowledge-service.ts` documents `handleRecordUpsert` (around :232) and `handleRecordDelete` (around :252) as applying "an ObjectQL `record.created` / `record.updated` event" and "an ObjectQL `record.deleted` event".

## Measured by the #20288 dev (`5883321020`), and read again in review `5883544890`

`IRealtimeService` has three in-repo producers, found by `git grep` over every `.publish(` call site in `packages/**/*.ts` outside tests:
- `objectql/src/engine.ts` `publishDataEvent` publishes `data.record.created|updated|deleted`;
- `publishBulkDataEvent` publishes `data.records.updated|deleted`;
- `metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` publishes `metadata.{type}.{action}`.

None publishes `record.*`. PR #20567 removes `record.*` from the spec's `RealtimeEventType`, because nothing emits it.

## Not measured

- Whether any producer outside this repository (cloud, or a third-party plugin that publishes through `IRealtimeService`) still sends `record.*`. The #4626 comment suggests the branch was kept for such a shape on purpose.

## For triage

Two things read wrong today. The TSDoc names `record.*` as the ObjectQL vocabulary, while ObjectQL publishes `data.record.*`. And `payload.record ?? payload` is a consumer-side fallback for a legacy shape. Whether the branch is retired or kept (and then documented as a legacy-producer shape rather than ObjectQL's) is triage's and the services lane's call.

Dedupe words: `knowledge-event-sync record.created legacy branch` · `handleRecordUpsert payload.record` · `service-knowledge record.* TSDoc`
